typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		assignment_group as string,
		assigned_to as string,
		number as string,
		{parent ref_change_request risk} as string,
		impact as string,
		state as string,
		planned_start_date as date,
		planned_end_date as date,
		short_description as string,
		sys_class_name as string,
		change_task_type as string,
		{cmdb_ci location} as string,
		cmdb_ci as string,
		{parent ref_change_request requested_by} as string,
		{parent ref_change_request unauthorized} as string,
		close_code as string,
		closed_at as date,
		made_sla as string,
		{parent ref_change_request outside_maintenance_schedule} as string,
		{parent ref_change_request production_system} as string,
		escalation as string,
		close_notes as string,
		{change_request number} as string,
		{cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name} as string,
		{cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number} as string,
		{cmdb_ci u_wf_guid} as string,
		{parent cmdb_ci} as string,
		{parent cmdb_ci location} as string,
		{parent cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name} as string,
		{parent cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		BuildingCampusName as string,
		ConfigurationItem as string,
		MadeSLA as string,
		Escalation as string,
		ProductionSystem as string,
		AssignmentGroup as string,
		Risk as string,
		CloseCode as string,
		ParentWorkplaceLocationNumber as string,
		ShortDescription as string,
		ParentCILocation as string,
		PlannedStartDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Number as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		ParentCI as string,
		TaskType as string,
		Unauthorized as string,
		WorkplaceLocationNumber as string,
		Impact as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ParentBuildingCampusName as string,
		OutsideMaintenanceSchedule as string,
		AssignedTo as string,
		Type as string,
		State as string,
		Closed as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CloseNotes as string,
		PlannedEndDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		u_wf_guid as string,
		RequestedBy as string,
		Location as string,
		ChangeRequestNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BuildingCampusName = {cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name},
		ConfigurationItem = cmdb_ci,
		MadeSLA = made_sla,
		Escalation = escalation,
		ProductionSystem = {parent ref_change_request production_system},
		AssignmentGroup = assignment_group,
		Risk = {parent ref_change_request risk},
		CloseCode = close_code,
		ParentWorkplaceLocationNumber = {parent cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number},
		ShortDescription = short_description,
		ParentCILocation = {parent cmdb_ci location},
		PlannedStartDate = planned_start_date,
		Number = number,
		ETLUser,
		ParentCI = {parent cmdb_ci},
		TaskType = sys_class_name,
		Unauthorized = {parent ref_change_request unauthorized},
		WorkplaceLocationNumber = {cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_workplace_location number},
		Impact = impact,
		UploadDate,
		ParentBuildingCampusName = {parent cmdb_ci location ref_sn_wsd_core_building campus name},
		OutsideMaintenanceSchedule = {parent ref_change_request outside_maintenance_schedule},
		AssignedTo = assigned_to,
		Type = change_task_type,
		State = state,
		Closed = closed_at,
		CloseNotes = close_notes,
		PlannedEndDate = planned_end_date,
		u_wf_guid = {cmdb_ci u_wf_guid},
		RequestedBy = {parent ref_change_request requested_by},
		Location = {cmdb_ci location},
		ChangeRequestNumber = {change_request number}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
